**Section C: Comprehension (5 marks).** Read the passage below and answer the questions that follow. Use complete sentences and, as far as possible, your own words. The passage (culled and adapted from *Writing and Grammar* by Pearson) discusses how technology evolves to meet new challenges, and the benefits modern "cutting-edge" technologies have brought to medicine, education and communication.

1. Identify 2 ways in which technology has evolved to meet up with new challenges. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown: 1. **(1)** When people felt cold, they learnt to make fire; when they discovered lakes and oceans, they built boats and ships to cross them. **(2)** People invented the airplane to travel free from the constraints of land, and later developed the processor and micro-processor — and eventually the internet — to meet the need for faster calculation and more efficient data transport.

2. In which ways has modern technology improved medicine and health care? (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown: 2. **Modern technology has made laser surgery available, restoring the sight of people who, in an earlier era, would almost certainly have remained blind.** It has also made possible modern surgical procedures such as the transplant of organs like the heart and kidney, saving the lives of people whose condition would previously have ended their lives prematurely.

3. The computer has been referred to as a "private teacher to students". What can it do? (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown: 3. **Computer programmes can correct errors in grammar and spelling, and can make suggestions for improving one's writing** — functioning almost like having a personal tutor close at hand.

5. Have you ever used any modern gadgets? How do they contribute to the wellbeing of your family? Give any two reasons not mentioned in the text. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown: 5. **Réponse personnelle**, par exemple : les smartphones et applications de navigation (GPS) aident la famille à se déplacer plus facilement et en sécurité dans des lieux inconnus ; des gadgets comme les téléviseurs connectés ou les enceintes musicales offrent un divertissement partagé qui renforce les moments passés en famille.

incertitudes: La question 5 appelle une réponse personnelle ; les raisons proposées doivent explicitement être différentes de celles déjà citées dans le texte (chirurgie laser, correction grammaticale, communication), conformément à la consigne.
